```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(wesanderson)
library(gt)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r process_pollution_data, echo = FALSE}
# function that takes input dataset, cleans it, and calculates user pref (ppb)

# inputs for function: file path and o3 units
# output for function: clean tibble with single row per day

process_pollution_data <- function(file_path, o3_units = "ppm") {
  air_data <- read.csv(file_path) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    # format date
    mutate(Date = mdy(Date))

  # loop through pollutants and set negative to 0

  pollutants <- c("Daily.Max.8.hour.CO.Concentration",
                  "Daily.Mean.PM2.5.Concentration",
                  "Daily.Max.8.hour.Ozone.Concentration")

  for (i in pollutants) {
    air_data[[i]] <- ifelse(air_data[[i]] < 0, 0, air_data[[i]])
  }

  # for duplicate measurements, calculate daily average
  air_data <- air_data |>
    group_by(Date) |>
    summarise(
      co = mean(.data$Daily.Max.8.hour.CO.Concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
      units_co = first(.data$units_CO),
      pm25 = mean(.data$Daily.Mean.PM2.5.Concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
      units_pm = first(.data$units_PM),
      o3 = mean(.data$Daily.Max.8.hour.Ozone.Concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
      units_o3 = first(.data$units_O3),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # remove duplicate rows
  air_data <- air_data |>
    distinct()

  # choosing ppm or ppb
  if (o3_units == "ppb") {
    air_data$o3 <- (air_data$o3) * 1000
    air_data$units_o3 <- "ppb"
  }
  air_data
}

air2018 <- process_pollution_data("data/AQ_2018.csv", o3_units = "ppm")
air2019 <- process_pollution_data("data/AQ_2019.csv", o3_units = "ppm")
air2020 <- process_pollution_data("data/AQ_2020.csv", o3_units = "ppm")

# combining into a single data set
air_3years <- rbind(air2018, air2019, air2020)
```

## Summary Tables for Pollutants for 2018 - 2020

```{r tables, echo=FALSE}
# tables include max and min of each pollutant

# 2018
air2018_summary <- data.frame(
  Pollutant = c("CO (ppm)", "PM2.5 (ug/m^3)", "O3 (ppm)"),
  Minimum = c(
    minco = round(min(air2018$co, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    minpm25 = round(min(air2018$pm25, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mino3 = round(min(air2018$o3, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  ),
  Maximum = c(
    maxco = round(max(air2018$co, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    maxpm25 = round(max(air2018$pm25, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    maxo3 = round(max(air2018$o3, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  )
)
air2018_summary |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header("Air Quality Summary for 2018") |>
  tab_caption("Minimum and Maximum Values for Pollutants")

# 2019
```

# Plot 1: Monthly Average Co and O3 Concentration for 2018 - 2020

```{r graphs, echo= FALSE}
# average across the three years
air_3years <- air_3years |>
  mutate(
    month = month(Date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
    o3_10ppm = o3 * 10
  )

month_sum <- air_3years |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(
    mean_co = mean(co, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_o3 = mean(o3_10ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_co = sd(co, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_o3 = sd(o3_10ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_co = sum(!is.na(co)),
    n_o3 = sum(!is.na(o3)),
    lower_co = mean_co - 1.96 * (sd_co / sqrt(n_co)),
    upper_co = mean_co + 1.96 * (sd_co / sqrt(n_co)),
    lower_o3 = mean_o3 - 1.96 * (sd_o3 / sqrt(n_o3)),
    upper_o3 = mean_o3 + 1.96 * (sd_o3 / sqrt(n_o3)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
month_sum <- month_sum |>
  select(month, mean_co, mean_o3, lower_co, upper_co, lower_o3, upper_o3)

month_plot <- ggplot(
  data = month_sum,
  aes(x = month)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      y = mean_co, color = "CO, in ppm"
    )
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(
    y = mean_co,
    ymin = lower_co,
    ymax = upper_co,
    color = "CO, in ppm"
  )) +
  geom_point(aes(
    y = mean_o3, color = "O3, per 10 ppm"
  )) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(
    y = (mean_o3),
    ymin = (lower_o3),
    ymax = (upper_o3),
    color = "O3, per 10 ppm"
  ))

month_plot +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Mean Concentration of Pollutants",
    color = "Pollutants"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = wes_palette("Darjeeling1", 2)
  )
```

To best scale the pollutants so that the true relationship between the month and mean concentration is seen for both pollutants, I multiplied the O3 pollutant by 10, meaning that the unit is not 10 ppm (parts per million). This allows the width of each confidence interval to be seen on in the same level as CO, which is measured in ppm.


## Plot 2: PM 2.5 by Month from 2018 - 2020

```{r plot2, echo = FALSE}
air_3years <- air_3years |>
  mutate(year_pm = year(Date))

p25_sum <- air_3years |>
  group_by(year_pm, month) |>
  summarise(
    mean_p25 = mean(pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
Year <- factor(p25_sum$year_pm)
p25_plot <- ggplot(
  data = p25_sum,
  aes(
    x = month,
    y = mean_p25,
    group = Year,
    color = Year
  )
)
p25_plot +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Average PM2.5 (ug/m^3)"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = wes_palette("Darjeeling1", 3)
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

To best display the data, I used a line plot, so that the pattern over the months can be clearly seen by the line, and I am able to add different lines to represent the 3 different years.


## Interpretation of Data

From the yearly air quality summary tables, PM 2.5 exhibited a large range of values, ranging from about 0 to 30 ug/m^3 over the years, while CO and O3 have much narrower ranges, which CO ranging from approximately 0.1 to 1.3 ppm, and O3 ranging from approximately 0.01 to 0.068 ppm. 

Plot 1 displays the monthly average of CO and O3 over the three years, and we can see an inverse pattern between the two pollutants depending on the season, for example, O3 is the highest during the summer months (maximum occurs in June), and lowest in the winter months, while CO is highest during the winter months (maximum occurs in December), and lowest in the summer months.

Plot 2 displays the average monthly concentration of PM 2.5 for the years 2018 to 2020 (up until April), and no clear seasonal or yearly pattern is seen.
